guard_restored_restarted: Configuration restored to backup {id} and board restarted. Reason: {reason}

guard_board_halted: The board stayed halted after restarting
guard_nobody_confirmed: Nobody confirmed the new configuration within {sec} s

cam_tl_scheduled_failed: The scheduled timelapse could not start: {error}

cam_load_critical: Camera relay under critical load ({reason}): 2 remote screens left per camera

health_volt_low: Undervoltage on the system power supply: check the supply and the cable.

health_wifi_down_net: WiFi down or the router is not responding. Network: {ssid}

health_disk_ok: System space OK again: {free_gb} GB free.

health_base_big: The service database weighs {mb} MB (alert from {limit} MB). Check System health > Database.

pid_finished: PID of all the zones of T{tool}: finished ({good} of {total} good)

notice_kind_camera_deleted: Camera: videos or photos about to be deleted

main_records_temperature_power_while_hea: Records temperature and power while a heater is tuned, so the chart can be seen from any screen.
machine_workarea_bad_rect_not_numbers: The area needs four numbers (X min, X max, Y min, Y max)
machine_workarea_bad_rect_too_small: The area is smaller than 10 mm: it looks like a capture error
machine_workarea_bad_rect_outside_travel: The area goes outside the travel of the axes
machine_workarea_no_reading: The corner measurement did not leave a position (the reason is in the console of DWC)
machine_workarea_busy: A work area step is already running
machine_workarea_refuse_macro_missing: The corner macros are missing on the card (handfree.g, handcorner.g, gotobed.g, framecutarea.g of the Workbench plugin)
machine_workarea_refuse_not_homed: X and Y must be homed first
machine_workarea_refuse_no_area: The mode in use has no saved area to walk
machine_height_conflict: The calibration changed while you were editing it: check the values and save again
machine_height_no_reading: The probe did not return a valid height
machine_height_busy: A height calibration step is already running
machine_height_refuse_macro_missing: The height calibration macros are missing on the card (zcal-*.g of the Workbench plugin)
machine_height_refuse_not_homed: X, Y and Z must be homed first
machine_height_refuse_no_probe: The machine has no probe in this mode
machine_height_refuse_szp_not_fff: The scanning probe (SZP) only exists in FFF mode
machine_height_refuse_no_szp: There is no probe K1 (SZP) in this mode
livejob_bridge_down: The G-code bridge is not running: the live job cannot be stopped or resumed
livejob_bridge_old: The installed G-code bridge is older than the safe stop: install it again (sudo ./install.sh in the bridge folder)
livejob_bridge_no_answer: The G-code bridge did not answer in time
livejob_no_job: There is no live job to stop
livejob_stop_failed: The job could not be stopped
livejob_stop_failed_why: The safe stop was not completed: {why}
livejob_stop_timeout: The machine did not finish the lines it had already accepted in time: the job goes on; try again or use the emergency stop if there is danger
livejob_stopped: Job stopped safely at line {n}: laser off and position saved. It can be resumed.
livejob_unknown_record: That interrupted job does not exist any more
trace_since_unknown_job: There is no recorded trace of that job
trace_since_bad_job: The job must be "current" or an id like 20261024-153000
trace_since_bad_cursor: That cursor is not one given by trace.since
livejob_armed: Resume armed: send the same job again from the program (30 minutes)
livejob_blocked_not_resumable: This job cannot be resumed (only laser jobs)
livejob_blocked_machine_unknown: The state of the machine is unknown: wait for it to answer
livejob_blocked_not_laser: Resume only works in Laser mode
livejob_blocked_job_running: A live job is running: resume cannot be armed
livejob_blocked_machine_busy: The machine is busy: wait until it is free
livejob_blocked_rebooted: The board restarted after the stop: the origins and offsets are gone, start the job again
camera_relay_frames_not_kept: That video did not keep its stills: only one recorded with "keep the stills" can be rebuilt
